map.由高度求无初速自由下落时间。: Time of free fall from rest given height.
map.掉落物到达时间估算。: Estimate time for a dropped object to arrive.
map.由下落高度反推落到地面所需的时间（忽略空气阻力）。: Infer the time to reach the ground from fall height (ignoring air resistance).
map.t = √(2×100/9.8) = √20.41 ≈ 4.52 s。即百米高自: t = √(2×100/9.8) = √20.41 ≈ 4.52 s. That is, a 100 m free fall touches ground in about 4.5 s.
map.落差 45 m，重力加速度 9.8 m/s²: Drop height 45 m, gravitational acceleration 9.8 m/s²
map.理想自由落体无关（伽利略）；实际受空气阻力大物体略慢。: Ideal free fall does not (Galileo); in reality large air-resisted objects are slightly slower.
map.为什么时间只取决于高度，与物体质量无关？: Why does time depend only on height, not on the object's mass?
map.忽略空气阻力时，所有物体都以相同的 g 加速，质量在方程两边同时约掉——这正是伽: Ignoring air resistance, all objects accelerate by the same g, and mass cancels on both sides of the equation — this is exactly Galileo's falling-body conclusion. In reality with air resistance, light and fluffy objects are significantly slower than the theoretical value; this tool's result is the ideal lower bound.
